title: Deep-dive: root-cause the persistent 'Errors detected!' load warning
description: After 12+ XML/Lua fixups + applying every audit finding from ADDON_UI_GUIDE.md, the game still shows 'Errors detected! Disable this mod if you experience problems.' on the addon panel. The addon is fully functional — capture, indicator, GUI, navigation all work. Warning appears cosmetic but unknown what triggers it. Approach: (1) bisect by temporarily commenting out each <File> entry in DeathReplay.mod one at a time, /reloadui after each, to identify which file the validator dislikes. (2) If isolated to one file, narrow further by removing chunks of that file. (3) Once isolated, cross-reference against ADDON_UI_GUIDE.md for the offending construct. May ultimately need to enable disk logging via UserSettings.xml <Logging logAllToDisk="true"/> and verify it actually writes to logs/ui_errors.log this time — earlier attempts produced zero log output despite the flag.
close_reason: Resolved by 5-fix batch: (1) added xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation to both XML roots, (2) added <Scripts> block to both XMLs, (3) removed phantom EA_ChatWindow dependency, (4) changed date to M/D/YYYY format, (5) added WARInfo Categories+Careers block. Reference pattern from Deathblow2.mod/xml. User confirmed 'Errors detected!' warning gone after /reloadui.

title: Add /dr debug on|off slash subcommand to toggle debug chat output
description: v1 instrumentation (DR_TRACE, DR_DEBUG, DR_VERIFY, DR_PROBE, DR_PROBE_TEXT, dr_safe wraps) was useful for diagnosis but spams chat in normal play. Add a per-character config flag DeathReplay_SavedVariables.config.debug (default false) and a slash subcommand '/dr debug on' / '/dr debug off' to toggle. Gate every diagnostic chat print on the flag so silent-running is the default but users (or we) can re-enable when triaging issues. Also: cleanup pass to remove the now-unused DR_PROBE / DR_PROBE_TEXT one-shot probes that only existed for the WORLD_OBJ_COMBAT_EVENT diagnostics — those are obsolete now that combat capture works.

title: Layout polish for replay window — button row + timeline alignment + title bar
description:
v1 window renders functionally but has rough edges:
- Title and NavLabel at top-left look unaligned with the timeline below
- Prev/Next buttons + Dmg/Buffs checkboxes are in a row at y=78 with x=20/100/200/300 fixed offsets — should anchor relative to each other instead of fixed pixels so resizing/scaling stays clean
- Close button at top-right corner is fine but no proper TitleBar (advancedrenowntrainer uses <Window name="$parentTitleBar" inherits="EA_TitleBar_Default"/>)
- Timeline at y=120 leaves visible empty space between the button row and event list; should probably anchor below the last button-row element with a small offset
- Considering an explicit TitleBar child would give a draggable title strip and reclaim the layout pattern used by every other dialog addon
Reference patterns: Interface/AddOns/advancedrenowntrainer/AdvancedRenownTrainingImportDialog.xml lines 16-90 for canonical structure. Also worth re-examining whether 480x420 is the right outer Size now that content is more clearly visible.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text: Applied layout polish via canonical PotionBar/advancedrenowntrainer pattern: added EA_TitleBar_Default (draggable title strip with auto-positioned title text) and replaced custom close button with EA_Button_DefaultWindowClose (template auto-anchors to titlebar right edge — no more overlap with NavLabel). Background (FullResizeImage_MetalFill) now anchors below titlebar instead of stretching over it. Button row now chains via sibling anchors: Prev→below NavLabel, Next→Prev.topright+8, FilterDmg→Next.topright+32, FilterBuffs→FilterDmgLabel.topright+12 — kills the hardcoded x=20/100/200/300 pixel offsets. Added explicit Label widgets next to each checkbox for 'damage'/'buffs' text since EA_Button_DefaultCheckBox renders only the box. Timeline anchors below Prev with y+14 offset, killing the y=120 empty gap. Lua updated: title text now writes to DeathReplay_GUITitleBarText, removed obsolete ButtonSetText for the close button.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text: First attempt broke layout — window stretched across screen and inner widgets reversed. Root causes diagnosed: (1) 'inherits=EA_Window_Default' on the parent Window plus a TitleBar child appears to auto-expand the parent, (2) sibling-relative anchor chaining (topleft -> topright of sibling) reversed button order. Reverted to canonical QueueQueuer/PotionBar pattern: bare Window (no EA_Window_Default inherit), FullResizeImage_MetalFill full-cover bg, TitleBar + EA_Button_DefaultWindowClose still in place (those worked), but all body widgets now anchored absolutely to background.topleft with explicit x/y offsets that account for the ~32px titlebar height (NavLabel y=40, button row y=74, timeline y=116).
